# mode: every combination of flags -> effective mode [cause chain]
none -> Operating []
safe_mode -> SafeMode [SafeMode]
recovering -> Recovering [Recovering]
safe_mode+recovering -> SafeMode [SafeMode, Recovering]
draining -> Draining [Draining]
safe_mode+draining -> SafeMode [SafeMode, Draining]
recovering+draining -> Recovering [Recovering, Draining]
safe_mode+recovering+draining -> SafeMode [SafeMode, Recovering, Draining]
